attributes.name: raise_and_hold
attributes.text: The arm rises to a pose, holds it still, then lowers.
attributes.definition: An arm moves to a target position and the hand stays nearly motionless there for a clear pause before returning.

attributes.name: arm_extends_forward
attributes.text: The arm straightens forward away from the chest.
attributes.definition: The elbow extends so the hand moves forward from the body toward a point in front, ending with the arm nearly straight.

attributes.name: arms_raise_overhead
attributes.text: One or both arms lift until the hands are above the head.
attributes.definition: The hand moves upward past the head joint and ends higher than the top of the head.

attributes.name: fast_arm_swing_arc
attributes.text: The arm swings quickly through a wide arc.
attributes.definition: After drawing back, the arm moves rapidly along a curved path across or in front of the body, often with torso rotation.

attributes.name: leg_swings_out
attributes.text: One leg swings quickly forward or sideways with the knee straightening.
attributes.definition: A leg lifts off the floor and extends rapidly away from the body before returning.

attributes.name: back_and_forth_oscillation
attributes.text: The hand moves back and forth along a short line many times.
attributes.definition: A hand repeatedly reverses direction along roughly the same short straight path, without holding still between strokes.

attributes.name: twisting_rotation
attributes.text: A body part twists around its own long axis.
attributes.definition: The head, forearm or torso rotates in place rather than moving to a new location, seen as turning of the joints around the limb or spine axis.

attributes.name: circular_path
attributes.text: The hand travels in repeated circles.
attributes.definition: The hand traces a closed loop and repeats it, rather than moving back and forth along a line.

attributes.name: downward_press
attributes.text: The hand pushes downward from above.
attributes.definition: The hand or foot moves sharply down onto a point below it and stops, as a press or stamp.

attributes.name: pull_back_toward_body
attributes.text: The hand pulls back toward the own body.
attributes.definition: After reaching out, the hand returns toward the torso with a clear pulling movement, not a slow relaxed lowering.

attributes.name: hands_move_apart
attributes.text: The two hands start together and move apart.
attributes.definition: The distance between the two hands grows during the main part of the action.

attributes.name: hands_move_together
attributes.text: The two hands start apart and come together.
attributes.definition: The distance between the two hands shrinks until they meet or nearly meet in front of the body.

attributes.name: quick_flick
attributes.text: A short, fast snap of the hand.
attributes.definition: The hand makes one or two very brief rapid movements, mostly at the wrist, then stops.

attributes.name: stroke_along_surface
attributes.text: The hand slides along a body surface.
attributes.definition: The hand stays in contact with the head, face or other hand while sliding across it.
